Plane Makes Emergency Landing in Chennai After Engine Failure

An IndiGo flight bound for Colombo made an emergency landing at Chennai Airport on Tuesday night due to engine failure. A full emergency was declared at 9:55 pm. Another IndiGo flight, 6E4, traveling from London to Delhi, experienced a technical issue over the English Channel at an altitude of 24,000 feet and returned to Heathrow Airport for a safe emergency landing.
